Project Management Job Description
Join Amgen ’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen , if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year.

Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions.

As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
Senior Program Manager, Global Medical Affairs - Rare Disease & General Medicine

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will support the development and execution of Medical Strategy for Global Rare Disease and General Medicine Medical Affairs teams, including Dazodalibep and olpasiran.

This is a key role whose overarching objective is to drive the development and execution of Medical Strategy in collaboration with Medical Affairs Leads. In this vital role, you will ensure that key deliverables including medical plans, insights, budgets and goals are brought to completion.

The Senior Manager is a cross-functional, collaborative role across global, regional, and local Medical teams and partners. You will identify metrics, progress, interdependencies, and concerns, facilitate resolution as needed, and keep the Medical Affairs Team aligned around its priorities.
You will lead cross-functional planning, manage project risks, and drive resolution of complex issues while aligning strategic goals across the broader organization.

Drive the coordination and integration of insights in partnership with the Medical Affairs Lead to inform product strategy for global and local teams.
Be a key point of communication to ensure execution of the Medical Plan, including goal development and regular progress tracking.
Drive the Medical Plan process and ensure alignment between global, regional, and local Medical leads, including large and ROW/emerging markets.
Understand the Global Medical Strategy and ensure integration through close partnership with EGT, AUEG, IBT and other critical cross-functional partners.
Drive decision making within the Global Medical Affairs Team and ensure decisions, actions, and follow-up are clearly documented.
Identify key deliverables for each function and their interdependencies; maintain integrated plans
Implement standard methodologies and reinforce cross-functional alignment and accountability.
Identify project issues, risks, and resource gaps; facilitate resolution, contingency planning, and escalation as appropriate.
Reinforce sound decision making according to Amgen ’s Decision-Making Framework.
Monitor and communicate progress, adherence to timelines, and variance from plan to Medical Affairs leadership.
Facilitate resource planning, financial planning, and capacity assessments in partnership with Medical Operations, Finance, and functional leaders.
Conduct risk management, contingency, and scenario planning using a variety of project-management tools.
Support continuous improvement of Rare Disease & General Medicine Medical planning, governance, and ways of working.
Drive operational excellence and automation by applying approved emerging technologies, including AI tools such as Copilot, to strengthen Medical planning, reporting, and ways of working.
What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The qualified professional we seek is a Senior Manager with strong program-management experience and the ability to work effectively in a complex, global matrix environment.
Given close partnership with USML, GMAL, and global cross-functional stakeholders, the Senior Manager must maintain working hours with meaningful Pacific Time overlap. Availability generally from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Pacific Time, plus flexibility for key meetings, business priorities, and global deliverables, is required.

Experience supporting Rare Disease, General Medicine, specialty, or other complex therapeutic-area portfolios.
Experience in a role requiring broad communication across multiple groups, levels, and interest groups, with responsibility for influencing change and results.

Comfort working through ambiguity and helping create structure when priorities, ownership, or next steps are still evolving. This includes asking thoughtful questions, identifying options, proposing next steps, and helping the team move from discussion to action.

Experience with and curiosity about AI and emerging technologies, with a demonstrated interest in advancing practical solutions to business challenges
What you can expect of us
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Dein Aufgabenbereich
Ab Projektierungsbeginn bis zur Inbetriebnahme der Gewerke stellst du \- in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Bauherrschaft \- ein qualitativ hochwertiges Projektmanagement sicher.
Du koordinierst sämtliche am Projekt beteiligten Fachplaner, Unternehmer, Lieferanten, Spezialisten und Behörden.
Dir obliegt die Überwachung der Gesamtkosten, Termine und Qualität sowie des Vertragsmanagements.
Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson der internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen in den verschiedenen Phasen des Projektes und bietest mit deiner Erfahrung eine Unterstützung für unsere jungen Teammitglieder.
Deine Fähigkeiten und Talente
Wir suchen DICH, ein aufgestelltes, sympathisches und positiv denkendes neues Teammitglied.
Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium als Bauingenieur / Architekt ETH / FH oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung.
Zu deiner mehrjährigen Erfahrung als Projektmanager:in und der Gesamtleitung von anspruchsvollen Projekten kannst du auch auf eine hohe betriebswirtschaftliche Kompetenz zählen.
Du überzeugst durch deine integrative Persönlichkeit mit Überzeugungs\-, Motivations\- und Durchsetzungsvermögen sowie deinem souveränen Auftritt im Umgang mit verschiedenen internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen.
Von aussen wirst du als analytisch, konzeptionell und innovativ denkend mit ausgezeichneten Umsetzungsfähigkeiten wahrgenommen.
Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit CAD sowie mit Messerli BAUAD.
Darauf darfst du dich freuen
Es erwarten dich anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem zukunftsgerichteten, lebendigen Unternehmen.

Job Description

The (Senior) Market Access Value Proposition Manager (Market Access Manager) ensures customized value propositions to Payers, Regulators, Providers and Health insurers, including clinical, economic and political arguments in order to grant Access for patients to companies products.

* Provide customized value proposition to internal and external stakeholders
* Be an active part within Brand teams and identify opportunities to work collaboratively with cross-functional colleagues to deliver on Brand objectives.
* Be the link between Business Unit Directors, Sales, Finance, Governmental Affairs and Market Access
* Customize technical data into simple compelling messages in the format required and appropriate for local stakeholders
* Define Value Propositions by consolidating core value dossiers, stakeholder needs, local environment and Brand priorities
* Propose to Brand teams and provide training of analysis, tools, evidence, actions and programs to support and communicate the value propositions
* Monitor changes and competitive situation in the environment in order to anticipate risks and opportunities for Market Access in collaboration with Governmental affairs
* Develop pricing scenarios, strategies and monitor prices together with Market Access Director
* Prepare submissions, objections handling and negotiation with authorities
* Attend field visits together with the key account managers with customers
* Attend congresses and networking events
* Provide Q&A for the Regional team

* University degree (Masters preferred) in Natural Science, Economics, Swiss Politics or Law
* Experience within pharmaceutical industry or in the health care environment
* Ability to oversee the political healthcare landscape, its participants and stakeholders as well as its interconnectedness
* Experiences in negotiation with authorities or Health Insurances (Art. 71)
* Ability to translate technical messages into compelling value-stories
* Marketing and/or Sales experience (desirable, not essential)
* Business fluent in German, English and ideally French

* Driven, passionate, ambitious
* Keen on maximize AbbVie success through professional Market Access work
* Keep one step ahead of changes and have a good sense of the future of the Brands.
* Team player and work well in a matrix organization to share insights and to develop the propositions
* Speaks clearly and fluently; makes presentations and undertakes public speaking with skill and confidence / is able to take complex information and explain things in simple terms to people who are not familiar with the complexity

Narvar is growing! We are hiring a Technical Project Manager to drive our most complex, multi-team engineering initiatives — the ones with no single owning team, where progress depends on getting the sequencing right across groups that don't naturally coordinate with each other.
This is not a status-reporting role. You won't be writing production code, but you will build and maintain the real dependency graph behind a project: which team's output blocks which other team's start, where the critical path actually runs, and what has to happen in what order for the whole thing to land.

You'll follow technical discussions closely enough to spot those dependencies before they become blockers, and you'll proactively pull in the right people — across engineering, product, design, data, or leadership — before gaps turn into delays.

Dependency mapping and critical path management
Map cross-team dependencies for projects that span multiple engineering teams with no single owning team — identify what blocks what, and in what order work needs to happen
Maintain a live view of the critical path, not just individual teams' task lists, and flag when a slip in one team changes the achievable timeline for others
Surface hidden or emerging dependencies before they become blockers, particularly ones that no single team has visibility into because they sit at the seams between teams
Distill the graph into concise, honest updates for non-technical stakeholders and leadership — what's driving the timeline, what's at risk, and why
Cross-functional coordination
Identify when product management, design, data, legal, or other stakeholders need to be looped in — and act on it proactively, without waiting for engineers to flag it
Recognize when a dependency crosses team boundaries and make sure the teams on both sides of it are actually talking to each other, not just individually on track
Chase down answers, escalate when needed, and keep work moving forward
Serve as the connective tissue across engineering and adjacent functions throughout the delivery lifecycle — especially where no single team is positioned to see the whole picture
Technical context and decision support
Follow technical discussions closely enough to grasp the tradeoffs being made — architecture decisions, infrastructure choices, API design, build vs. buy — and understand how those choices ripple into other teams' work
Reason about sequencing implications of technical decisions: does this choice change what can be built in parallel versus what must be serial?
Surface implications of technical decisions for timeline, scope, or other teams
Know when a decision warrants broader input and facilitate getting it, without creating unnecessary process overhead
Documentation and operational hygiene
Keep the dependency graph, specs, decisions, and timelines documented and accessible
Ensure decisions made in Slack or ad-hoc meetings don't get lost, especially ones that affect teams beyond the room they were made in
Make it easy for anyone joining a project mid-stream to get up to speed quickly — including understanding why the sequencing is what it is

Systems and dependency thinking: You can look at multiple teams' plans and identify where they interlock — where a change in one ripples into another — even when no one team has full visibility into the whole
Technical fluency: You don't need to write code, but you need to follow engineering conversations comfortably — architecture diagrams, system tradeoffs, sprint planning — without hand-holding
Project management experience: 4+ years managing complex, multi-team software projects with several workstreams and stakeholders in a fast-moving environment — ideally including projects with no single owning team
Strong written communication: Able to distill a complex dependency picture into crisp, accurate updates for non-technical audiences
Proactive by default: You identify when to loop someone in without being asked, and you follow through without needing to be chased
Calm under ambiguity: Able to drive clarity and keep work moving without waiting for perfect information, a fully defined process, or a single team to own the outcome
Cross-functional credibility: Comfortable holding a room with engineers, product managers, designers, and executives — and earning trust from all of them

Prior experience as a software engineer, QA, or technical analyst
Familiarity with agile and scrum methodologies; experience with tools like Jira, Linear, or Shortcut, especially for modeling cross-team dependencies
Experience running programs (not just single-team projects) — i.e., initiatives coordinated across multiple teams toward a shared outcome
Experience working with distributed or remote engineering teams

s.h: KEY ESSENTIALS TO BEHAVIOR MANAGEMENT CORP
s.t:
BCBA — Remote Program Manager
Fully Remote · Telehealth Clinical Leadership
Role
BCBA — Remote Program Manager
$90,000 – $110,000/year (Exempt, Salaried)

$50 – $60/hr
Employment Type
Full-time and Part-time positions available · Fully Remote
Reports To
Clinical Director (Jazmin) with Chief Clinical Director (Maritza) oversight
Location
Fully Remote — Georgia residency preferred for state licensure alignment
Service Setting
100% Telehealth — virtual clinical delivery, virtual supervision, virtual team leadership
Core Hours
2:00 PM – 7:00 PM PST, minimum 5 hours visible presence (camera on)
Billable Split
70% direct billable · 30% indirect billable
Credential
Active BCBA Certification · Master's required · 3+ years post-cert experience · State licensure current · Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote workspace required
Why This Role Exists
Most remote BCBA jobs are thin wrappers around case management — you read reports, sign off on treatment plans from a couch, and rarely touch actual clinical supervision. KEBM built the Remote Program Manager role differently.

You lead a team of BCBAs and behavior technicians via telehealth, carry a real billable caseload at a 70/30 direct-to-indirect split, and own program quality across virtual service delivery. This is clinical leadership for BCBAs who want remote flexibility without giving up real authority.

If you have the discipline to run a clinical operation without a physical office to walk into — and the professional setup to do it well — this is structured for you.

We're a five-clinic ABA therapy company with four locations across Southern California and one in Georgia, founded in 2016 by a BCBA with 25+ years in the field. Our team of 68+ professionals delivers evidence-based therapy through our proprietary S.O.C.I.A.L. P.O.D.S. methodology — and our Sensory Spot locations prove that therapy can actually feel like play.
We serve every client who walks through our doors — insurance-funded, private pay, open play, and camp families alike. We're women-founded, minority-owned, and we don't sacrifice clinical quality for profit. If you want to work somewhere that's serious about outcomes and serious about its people, you're in the right place.
How S.O.C.I.A.L. P.O.D.S. Work
S.O.C.I.A.L. P.O.D.S. is our proprietary pod-based group ABA model. Clients are grouped 3–6 per pod at a 1:3 facilitator ratio, with a supervisor always on-site and clinical support always available in every pod. We use a push-in / pull-out model for group and 1:1 work, and BCBAs provide real-time clinical oversight across pods.

As the Remote Program Manager, your role is to extend clinical leadership, supervision, and program quality to the virtual team — coaching BCBAs and behavior technicians who deliver services through telehealth, managing cases that are better served virtually, and ensuring the S.O.C.I.A.L.

P.O.D.S. methodology translates with fidelity to remote delivery.
Who We Serve
KEBM serves every client who walks through our doors — no tiers, no priority treatment, no "real clients vs. drop-ins." That means:
Insurance-funded ABA clients (Medi-Cal, Medicare, commercial insurance)
Private pay therapy clients
Open play participants at our Sensory Spot locations
Camp participants — spring break, winter break, summer, and any seasonal KEBM camp
Consultation clients in adult residential and group home settings
Telehealth clients — the population you'll serve directly as Remote Program Manager
A camp kid gets the same quality of care as an insurance client. A telehealth client gets the same quality of care as a clinic-based client. If that feels natural to you, you're going to fit here. If the idea of treating any of those clients as less-than bothers you, this isn't the place.

Lead and supervise a team of BCBA clinicians and behavior technicians remotely — virtual supervision sessions, team meetings, performance evaluations, and real-time coaching. You're running a clinical operation through a camera.
Carry a direct billable caseload (70% of your time) — FBAs, treatment plan authorship, progress monitoring, and clinical decision-making on your assigned cases via telehealth.
Own program quality across virtual service delivery — quality assurance processes, treatment fidelity monitoring, outcome measurement, and continuous improvement of KEBM's telehealth program.
Manage virtual crisis situations and escalations — remote emergency support, crisis protocol implementation, coordination with on-site teams when a client situation escalates beyond telehealth scope.
Ensure telehealth compliance end-to-end — HIPAA in remote operations, state-specific telehealth regulations, privacy protocols, and documentation standards for virtual service delivery.
Develop virtual training programs and drive staff competency — onboarding, ongoing professional development, telehealth service delivery protocols, and technical support for the virtual team.
Generate program data and reports — utilization metrics, outcome tracking, program presentations for the CD and CCD. Telehealth programs live or die by data — this is yours to own.
Maintain core presence hours (2:00 PM – 7:00 PM PST) with camera on — visible, available, responsive. This is not optional; it's the structural commitment remote clinical leadership requires.

s.h: In your first 90 days, success looks like
s.t: Full remote team integration established, caseload at 70/30 billable/indirect cadence, quality assurance baseline documented across telehealth service delivery, and first monthly program report delivered to the CD.

s.h: You might be perfect for this if
s.t:
You hold your BCBA with leadership experience — and you genuinely thrive working remotely. This is not a "I'll figure it out" role. The BCBAs who succeed here already know they work well in virtual environments.
You want clinical authority without the commute — and you're willing to show up for it. Remote clinical leadership requires MORE presence, not less — cameras on, visible availability, responsive communication.
You have the setup — professional remote workspace, reliable high-speed internet, proper lighting and audio, and the discipline to hold core hours. KEBM provides platforms; you provide the operating environment.
You read remote work as a medium, not an excuse — you understand that virtual clinical supervision is harder than in-person supervision, not easier. If you were looking for a remote BCBA job because you wanted less accountability, this isn't it.

5+ years post-BCBA clinical experience
Prior telehealth ABA service delivery experience
Multi-state licensure (CA + GA or additional states)
Bilingual (Spanish)
Experience developing or scaling virtual clinical programs

These are non-negotiable for a fully remote clinical leadership role. If you can't commit to every one of them, this isn't the right role for you.
Professional workspace — dedicated office space or room with a door that can close for client confidentiality and professional appearance on camera.
Reliable high-speed internet — sufficient bandwidth for video supervision without dropouts. Minimum 25 Mbps up/down recommended; hardwired connection preferred over Wi-Fi.

**TSG Switzerland SA, est une filiale du groupe TSG, un des plus grands fournisseurs européens d-équipements et de services pour la distribution multi-énergies (électricité, gaz, hydrogène et carburant) pour la mobilité.

TSG fournit des solutions clé en main, notamment aux exploitants de stations-service et aux entreprises de transport de toutes tailles, y compris des systèmes de paiement. L-entreprise TSG, active dans toute la Suisse, emploie plus de 100 collaborateurs, dont la majorité à Givisiez (FR).

La croissance est soutenue pour le Groupe et également en Suisse (TEPU, Solar Alliance).**
HR TOP SA est aujourd-hui mandaté pour assurer le recrutement et la sélection d-un.e futur.e cadre supérieur.e afin de palier le prochain départ en retraite du titulaire de la fonction suivante :
**Responsable Département Projets & Service (fr-all)**
***Rejoignez ceux qui façonnent la mobilité de demain.***
Il y a des postes qui ressemblent à une étape. Et il y a des postes qui ressemblent à une mission.
Chez TSG, chaque station-service, chaque shop, chaque borne de recharge électrique raconte une histoire?: celle d-une Suisse qui avance, qui se transforme, qui choisit une mobilité plus propre, plus intelligente, plus humaine. Nous cherchons aujourd-hui la personne qui prendra la responsabilité d-un département essentiel à sa pérennité.
**Votre rôle :**
En tant que **Responsable Département Projets & Service**, vous devenez le point d-équilibre entre nos équipes, nos clients, nos partenaires et notre vision. Votre mission est vaste, exigeante, passionnante :
* Vous guidez l-équipe Service-Admin / Helpdesk avec bienveillance et exigence
* Vous soutenez nos techniciens en Suisse, véritables artisans de la mobilité du futur
* Vous développez les activités de maintenance, garantissant la fiabilité de nos infrastructures pour toutes nos activités et entités
* Vous entretenez et renforcez les relations commerciales, parce que la confiance est au cœur de nos valeurs
* Vous faites grandir les ventes de prestations de service**,** en apportant des solutions qui ont du sens
* Vous pilotez le budget du département Projets & Service, avec une vision claire et responsable
* Vous fluidifiez la communication entre les secteurs, pour que chaque projet avance comme une mécanique bien huilée
A terme, vous devenez une personne clé dans l-organisation de TSG sur le site de Givisiez. Un rôle qui ne se reçoit pas. Un rôle qui se mérite.
**Ce que vous apportez :**
Vous êtes une personne qui aime construire, fédérer, résoudre. Une personne qui sait que la technique n-a de valeur que lorsqu-elle sert l-humain. Une personne qui voit plus loin que son cahier de charges.
**Votre profil :**
* Formation supérieure en gestion d-entreprise ou ingénierie (Bachelor, Master, MBA)
* Langue maternelle **française ou allemande**, **excellente maîtrise de l-autre langue** (italien = vrai atout)
* Minimum 5 ansd-expérience dans une fonction cadre supérieur
* Expérience confirmée en gestion d-équipes et secteurs multidisciplinaires
* Leadership naturel et inspirant, capacité à structurer et réaliser
* Capacité organisationnelle et compétences en gestion de projets, orientation solutions et service client
* Aisance relationnelle, communication fluide et objective dans les deux langues requises
**Pourquoi ce poste est différent ?**
Parce que vous ne venez pas seulement gérer un département. Vous venez contribuer à un réseau qui alimente la Suisse, la relie, la transforme. Vous venez donner du sens à votre expertise. Ce rôle s-adresse à une personne prête à prendre un rôle impactant, à incarner une vision, à devenir un pilier du développement organisationnel.
**Prêt à faire partie de l-histoire??** Envoyez-nous votre dossier par le lien de cette annonce. Votre énergie, votre expérience et votre engagement peuvent changer la manière dont la Suisse transforme sa mobilité et les nouvelles énergies.

SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE: Applicants must have at least one (1) year of specialized experience at the next lower grade GS-14, or equivalent in other pay systems.

Examples of specialized experience includes knowledge of strategic planning and analytical/evaluative methods sufficient to develop short- and long-range plans, design management reporting and metric systems, and translate broad senior-level policy and Commander's intent into executable programs of command-wide and interagency consequence.

Knowledge of program and project management principles, methodologies, and governance frameworks sufficient to direct the full lifecycle of complex, mission-critical programs and projects that are national in scope, and to distinguish between continuous, statutorily funded programs and finite projects in order to apply the appropriate management approach to each.

TIG applies if you are in a current GS position or held a GS position within the previous 52 weeks. NOTE: Applicants applying as VEOA candidates who are current GS civil service employees or are prior GS civil service employees within the past 52 weeks must also meet time-in-grade requirements.

Skill in developing original analytical frameworks, methodologies, and policies in situations where existing guidelines are incomplete, conflicting, or nonexistent.

Skill in strategic planning sufficient to develop short- and long-range plans and translate broad senior-level policy and leadership intent into executable programs with measurable outcomes. 3.

Skill in stakeholder engagement, negotiation, and consensus-building sufficient to influence senior officials and reconcile conflicting interests on complex and controversial issues involving substantial resources or significant policy change. 4.

Skill in oral and written communication sufficient to prepare and present findings, evaluations, and recommendations to senior leaders and to represent an organization in executive-level meetings and forums. 5.

Skill in applying supervisory and management principles to direct the work of subordinates, including assigning work, evaluating performance, developing employees, and resolving personnel and conduct issues. 6.

Skill in financial stewardship and resource management sufficient to plan, justify, and allocate funding in support of program objectives across multiple appropriations and fiscal years in an environment of competing priorities. PART-TIME OR UNPAID EXPERIENCE: Credit will be given for appropriate unpaid and or part-time work.

You must clearly identify the duties and responsibilities in each position held and the total number of hours per week.

VOLUNTEER WORK EXPERIENCE: Refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service Programs (i.e., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student and social).

The Program Manager plays a critical role in driving the successful execution of strategic product initiatives across the organization. This role serves as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, and Go-to-Market teams, ensuring alignment from strategy through delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong program management expertise with a background in product management and engineering, enabling them to navigate technical complexity, influence decision-making, and accelerate business outcomes.

s.t:
Product & Program Leadership
Lead complex, cross-functional product and technology initiatives from concept through launch and adoption
Partner with Product and Engineering leaders to translate business objectives into executable plans and measurable outcomes
Drive alignment across stakeholders, balancing customer needs, technical constraints, and business priorities
Help define and operationalize processes that improve product development velocity and predictability
Strategic Planning & Roadmap Execution
Collaborate with Product Management to support roadmap planning, prioritization, and delivery sequencing
Ensure dependencies, resource needs, risks, and trade-offs are identified and addressed proactively
Facilitate quarterly and annual planning processes across Product and Engineering organizations
Monitor initiative progress against business goals, milestones, and success metrics
Cross-Functional Delivery
Coordinate execution across Product, Engineering, UX, Marketing, Operations, and Customer-facing teams
Drive accountability for deliverables while maintaining focus on customer impact and business value
Remove obstacles, resolve cross-team dependencies, and enable teams to deliver efficiently at scale
Support launch readiness activities and post-launch performance reviews
Technical Program Management
Partner closely with engineering teams to understand architecture, platform investments, and technical dependencies
Facilitate discussions involving system design, technical debt, scalability, reliability, and platform modernization
Ensure technical initiatives remain aligned with product strategy and organizational objectives
Translate complex technical concepts into clear business context for executive and non-technical stakeholders
Stakeholder Communication & Reporting
Build executive-level visibility into program health, roadmap progress, risks, and key decisions
Develop concise status updates, business reviews, and leadership presentations
Drive governance processes and decision-making frameworks for strategic initiatives
Proactively escalate risks and provide actionable recommendations
Process, Tools & Continuous Improvement
Own and maintain program artifacts, roadmaps, project plans, and documentation within Jira and Confluence
Establish and enforce best practices for work management, sprint planning, dependency tracking, reporting, and documentation across Product and Engineering teams
Develop dashboards, reports, and workflow processes that provide visibility into roadmap progress, delivery health, and team performance
Drive improvements in planning, estimation, prioritization, and execution processes
Champion data-driven decision-making and operational excellence across Product and Engineering teams

s.h: Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.
s.t:
5-7+ years of experience in Program Management within SaaS, hosting, cloud, eCommerce, FinTech, or technology-driven organizations
Demonstrated success driving operational rigor, visibility, and scalable execution across Product and Engineering organizations.
Expert-level proficiency with Jira and Confluence, including experience managing roadmaps, backlogs, sprint planning, dependency tracking, reporting dashboards, workflow configuration, and cross-functional documentation
Experience leading complex, cross-functional product and technical programs from strategy through execution
Familiarity with product-led growth, platform engineering, developer tools, or customer-facing digital products
Strong understanding of product development lifecycles, software engineering practices, and Agile methodologies
Ability to partner effectively with Product Managers, Engineering Leaders, Architects, and Executive stakeholders
Demonstrated experience driving roadmap execution, managing dependencies, and delivering customer-facing products
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a bias toward action and results
Ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without direct authority, and align diverse stakeholder groups

## Projektleitung Pionierprojekt - Traumapädagogische, familiäre Intensivbetreuung ##
### 30% vorläufig befristet für die Aufbauphase vom 1. Januar bis 31. Dezember 2027. ###
Du möchtest Kindern in hoch belasteten Lebenslagen, für die es bisher kaum passende Wohnformen gibt, einen sicheren Lebensort ermöglichen?
Wirke mit am Aufbau eines neuen, familiären und traumapädagogischen Angebots im Kanton Luzern!
Ausgangslage
Die Fachstelle Kinderbetreuung Luzern und Subito Kriseninterventionen entwickeln im Auftrag des Kantons Luzern ein neues traumapädagogisches, familiäres Intensivbetreuungsangebot.

Das Angebot richtet sich an Kinder, Jugendliche und junge Erwachsene bis maximal 25 Jahre mit stark belastenden Bindungs- und Beziehungserfahrungen sowie herausfordernden Verhaltensweisen, für die bestehende stationäre Wohnformen oder Pflegeverhältnisse nicht ausreichend tragfähig sind.

Ziel ist es, dass die Kinder und Jugendlichen im Zuhause eines Menschen mit Ausbildung im Sozialbereich leben, der diese Aufgabe als Haupterwerb übernimmt und zusätzliche Unterstützung von weiteren Menschen aus dem eigenen sowie professionellen Umfeld erhält.
Die erste Projektphase vom 1. Januar 2027 bis 31. Dezember 2027 dient dazu, die fachlichen und organisatorischen Grundlagen sorgfältig zu entwickeln und die Umsetzung ab 2028 vorzubereiten. Dafür suchen wir eine initiative, verbindende und fachlich starke Persönlichkeit, die Freude daran hat, Neues aufzubauen, Menschen zusammenzubringen und traumapädagogisches Wissen wirksam in die Praxis zu übersetzen.
### Funktion ###
Projektleitung Traumapädagogische, familiäre Intensivbetreuung
### Pensum ###
30 %
### Dauer ###
Vorläufig befristet für die Aufbauphase 01.01.2027 bis 31.12.2027. Es besteht die Option einer Verlängerung bei Abschluss der ersten Projektphase.
### Projektziel ###
Aufbau des neuen Angebots: Erarbeitung von Konzept und Kooperationsgrundlagen, Rekrutierung und Anstellung von Betreuungspersonen, allgemeine Vorbereitung der Leistungserbringung, Zusammenarbeit mit externen Anspruchsgruppen aufbauen
### Arbeitsfeld ###
Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, Traumapädagogik, Pflegekinderwesen, stationäre Intensivbetreuung im familiären Umfeld
Deine Aufgabe
In der Rolle Projektleitung gestaltest du die Aufbauarbeit eines innovativen Angebots mit hoher fachlicher und gesellschaftlicher Bedeutung. Du entwickelst tragfähige Grundlagen, steuerst den Projektprozess, vernetzt zentrale Partnerinnen und Partner und bringst traumapädagogische Expertise so ein, dass ab 2028 ein wirksames, familiäres Intensivbetreuungsangebot starten kann.
Deine Hauptaufgaben konkret
* Aufbau der Projektorganisation mit den beiden Kooperationspartnerinnen Fachstelle Kinderbetreuung und Subito Kriseninterventionen und weiteren relevanten Anspruchsgruppen inkl. Leitung eines Projektteams
* Entwicklung des Konzepts für die traumapädagogische, familiäre Intensivbetreuung unter punktuellem Einbezug externer traumapädagogischer Expertise und in Zusammenarbeit mit den zukünftigen Betreuungspersonen
* Definition der Aufnahme- und Ausschlusskriterien sowie der konkreten Leistungsinhalte
* Erarbeitung einer tragfähigen Lösung für die Tagesstruktur, falls vorübergehend kein Schulplatz vorhanden ist
* Aufbau der Zusammenarbeit mit der Luzerner Psychiatrie und Erarbeitung einer Kooperationsvereinbarung
* Ausarbeitung der Stellenbeschriebe und Rekrutierung des künftigen Betreuungspersonals, gewünscht ist eine frühzeitige Einbindung der hauptbetreuenden Person in die Konzeptentwicklung
* Vorbereitung der Arbeitsverträge und weiterer Anstellungsunterlagen für Betreuungspersonen unter Einbezug juristischer Expertise
* Aufgleisung der fachlichen Unterstützung für die Betreuungspersonen, insbesondere Gruppensupervision
* Bekanntmachung des Projekts bei wichtigen zuweisenden Stellen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Leitungen der beiden Kooperationspartnerinnen
* Entwicklung von Instrumenten für die Auswertung der zweiten Pilotprojektphase sowie einer Struktur für den ausführlichen Zwischenbericht
* Erstellung des Berichts zur ersten Projektphase zuhanden der DISG/KOSEG inklusive Zustellung des Konzepts für das Leistungsangebot
Das bringst du mit
Wir suchen eine reflektierte, mutige und verbindende Persönlichkeit, die Freude und Leidenschaft für innovative Pionierarbeit mitbringt. Besonders relevant für diese Aufgabe sind:
* Ausbildung in Sozialer Arbeit, Sozialpädagogik, Heilpädagogik, Psychologie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe, idealerweise im stationären Bereich oder im Pflegekinderwesen
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in Traumapädagogik, Bindungstheorie und traumasensibler Beziehungsgestaltung
* Erfahrung in Projektleitung, Konzeptentwicklung und interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
* Bereitschaft zu einer gleichwertigen Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Anspruchsgruppen und Freude an partizipativen Entscheidungs- und Arbeitsformaten
* Sicherheit und Eigenständigkeit im schriftlichen Arbeiten, in der Berichterstattung, im Umgang mit digitalen Hilfsmitteln und im Aufbau fachlicher Grundlagen
* Hohe Selbständigkeit, eine sehr gute Arbeitsorganisation und Freude daran, aus Ideen konkrete nächste Schritte zu entwickeln
* Kommunikationsstärke, Vernetzungsfähigkeit und die Gabe, unterschiedliche Akteurinnen und Akteure konstruktiv einzubinden
Das bieten wir
* Eine sinnstiftende Projektaufgabe mit grosser fachlicher, gesellschaftlicher und menschlicher Relevanz
* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und eine hohe fachliche Autonomie beim Aufbau eines neuen kantonalen Pilotangebots
* Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Organisationen und Fachpersonen der Kinder- und Jugendhilfe mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
* Fachlichen Austausch mit traumapädagogischer Expertise
* Sehr flexible Arbeitsgestaltung im Rahmen des Projektauftrags
* Die Möglichkeit, Grundlagen für ein spezialisiertes Angebot mit nachhaltiger Wirkung zu schaffen
* Option auf längerfristige Rolle bei erfolgreicher Pilotphase
Worum es im Angebot geht
Im Zentrum des künftigen Angebots steht eine bewährte Idee aus dem nahen Ausland: Eine sozialpädagogische Fachperson stellt ihr eigenes Zuhause für die längerfristige Betreuung eines Kindes zur Verfügung und wird dafür in einem 100-Prozent-Pensum angestellt.

Sie wird von Menschen aus ihrem persönlichen Umfeld sowie von professionellen Unterstützungspersonen begleitet und entlastet. So entsteht ein tragfähiges Netz rund um das Kind und die betreuende Fachperson. Das Angebot verbindet Kontinuität, verlässliche Beziehungen, Schutz, Partizipation und traumasensible Begleitung.

Kinder und Jugendliche sollen einen äusseren und personalen sicheren Ort erleben, korrigierende Beziehungserfahrungen machen und gemeinsam mit Fachpersonen neue Handlungsroutinen entwickeln können.
Stellenantritt und weiteres Vorgehen
Der Stellenantritt ist per 1. Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung vorgesehen.

We are seeking a Program Manager, Specialty Care Program Management Support, functioning as a Task Order and Project Management professional, to provide high-level programmatic support to the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Specialty Care Program Office.

In this role, you will lead and coordinate complex program and project management activities across an integrated federal healthcare system, ensuring the successful planning, execution, and closeout of targeted specialty care initiatives aligned with VHA mission priorities.

This position requires a seasoned professional capable of navigating the policies, stakeholders, and operational demands inherent within a large, complex federal healthcare environment.

The ideal candidate is a highly organized, strategic thinker with a proven track record of driving program outcomes and motivating high performing teams within complex, matrixed organizations, someone who thrives in a fast-paced federal consulting environment, supports highly reliable outcomes, and communicates effectively with internal and external customers, including clinical, operational, and executive leadership stakeholders.

Serves as the primary Task Order Manager responsible for the full lifecycle of program and project management activities, including planning, initiating, executing, monitoring, and closing out deliverables in support of the VHA Specialty Care Program Office.

Assists VA leadership in the execution of targeted program goals by developing and maintaining detailed project plans, integrated master schedules, risk registers, and performance dashboards aligned with VHA strategic priorities.

Facilitates coordination across interdisciplinary teams, federal stakeholders, and contractor personnel to ensure program milestones are met on time, within scope, and in compliance with federal contracting and VA policy requirements.

Develops, reviews, and delivers high-quality programmatic artifacts including status reports, briefings, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and executive-level presentations for VHA Specialty Care leadership and program sponsors.

Identifies program risks, issues, and dependencies; leads root cause analyses; and recommends and implements corrective action plans to ensure continuity and performance of specialty care program operations.

Supports change management, stakeholder engagement, and communications planning efforts to drive adoption of program initiatives across the integrated VHA health care system, including coordination with VA Central Office, VISNs, and facility-level stakeholders.

Minimum of 10 years of experience in healthcare program and project management, including planning, initiating, managing, executing, and closing out programs within an integrated health care system. Master's Degree required in Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Business Administration, Program Management, or a closely related field.

Minimum of 6 years of experience supporting a large corporation or federal government agency, with demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder programs in a government or federal healthcare contracting environment.

Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Position of Public Trust (MBI or higher) and comply with all VA IT security, privacy, and access requirements, including completion of required VA onboarding and training.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship; U.S. citizenship may be required to meet federal security and VA access standards.

Active Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI), or equivalent certification of similar rigor, is required and must be maintained in good standing throughout the duration of the task order.

Prior direct experience supporting Veterans Health Administration (VHA), Veterans Affairs (VA) Central Office, or a Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN)-level program office in a federal contracting capacity.
Familiarity with VHA Specialty Care service lines, VHA Directives, and VA clinical program governance structures.
Experience with VA-specific project management and reporting tools such as the VA Project Management Accountability System (PMAS) or similar federal portfolio management platforms.
Knowledge of federal acquisition regulations (FAR) and task order management within a cost-reimbursable or T&M contracting vehicle.
Experience applying Agile, Lean, or other iterative program management methodologies within a federal health IT or clinical operations environment.

Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.
Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.
Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.
🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations
Chez Lifen, nous déployons nos solutions dans les hôpitaux de toute la France pour améliorer le quotidien des soignants et la qualité des soins.
L'équipe Customer Operations est le pont entre nos produits et les établissements de santé. Nous accompagnons chaque hôpital de A à Z dans l'implémentation de nos solutions : Lifen Documents & Lifen Intégration.
Notre équipe est composée de Project Managers et d'Operations Managers, tous pilotés par Loïc, notre Lead Customer Operations.

* Du analysierst grosse Datenbestände eigenständig - von der Datenaufbereitung bis zur Interpretation - mit SQL sowie Python oder PySpark und entwickelst datenbasierte Analyseansätze kontinuierlich weiter.
* Du begleitest den jährlichen Planungs- und Steuerungsprozess für deine Linie und verfolgst die Umsetzung der vereinbarten operativen und finanziellen Massnahmen über das Jahr.
* Du erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings für interne Anspruchsgruppen und Group Claims, vertrittst die zugrunde liegenden Zahlen und stellst die erforderliche Governance sicher.
* Du bist Sparringpartner:in für die Linienverantwortlichen und arbeitest eng mit Schadenbearbeitung, Underwriting, Aktuariat und Analytics zusammen, um Fachbereich, Daten und Steuerungsbedarf wirksam zu verbinden.
**Das zeichnet dich aus**
* Du verfügst über einen Hochschulabschluss in Wirtschaft, Statistik, Data Science, (Wirtschafts-)Mathematik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.
* Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Nichtlebenversicherung mit, idealerweise im Schaden- oder Performance-Umfeld, beispielsweise in den Bereichen Motorfahrzeuge, Sach oder Haftpflicht.
* Du arbeitest sicher mit SQL und Python, idealerweise auch mit PySpark, und hast Erfahrung mit grossen Datenbeständen sowie Reporting-Tools wie Power BI.
* Du kannst komplexe Analysen verständlich einordnen, klare und umsetzbare Empfehlungen formulieren und diese gegenüber Führungskräften überzeugend vertreten.
* Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, treibst Themen aktiv voran
* Du kommunizierst stilsicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Das Amt für Zusatzleistungen zur AHV/IV (AZL) ist eine Dienstabteilung des Sozialdepartements der Stadt Zürich. Es sorgt für die Sicherstellung einer angemessenen materiellen Existenz einkommensschwacher Zürcher\*innen.

Es richtet Zusatzleistungen an AHV- und IV-Rentenbeziehende, Überbrückungsleistungen für ältere Arbeitslose, Beiträge an Entlastungsangebote und die Akut- und Übergangspflege sowie die Energiekostenzulage aus.

Ausserdem ist das AZL für die Ausrichtung öffentlicher Pflegebeiträge an die stationäre Langzeitpflege sowie des kommunalen Solidaritätsbeitrags zuständig.
Sie wollen Verantwortung übernehmen, ein kleines Team führen und fachlich wirklich etwas bewegen? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig. Für unsere Fachabteilung 3 suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte, motivierte Persönlichkeit als Teamleiter\*in.
## Aufgaben ##
* Sie führen ein Team von fünf oder sechs Mitarbeitenden - personell und fachlich, mit Überblick und Herz.
* Sie vertreten die Abteilungsleitung umfassend und sind eine wichtige Ansprechperson im Alltag.
* Sie übernehmen fachliche Mitverantwortung für Ihren Themenbereich und entwickeln ihn mit.
* Sie behalten die Arbeitsabläufe im Blick und stellen sicher, dass Quantität und Qualität stimmen.
* Sie wirken aktiv in internen Fachkonferenzen, Abteilungssitzungen und weiteren Austauschformaten mit.
* Sie führen selbständig ein eigenes Sekretariat mit ca. 50 Fällen.
Bis maximal Ende des Jahres 2027 ist die Teamleitungsstelle als Springer-Teamleitungsstelle ausgestaltet und das Einsatzgebiet in den verschiedenen Abteilungen nach Bedarf variabel. Die definitive Übernahme des Teams erfolgt nach der ordentlichen Pensionierung der aktuellen Teamleitung.
## Profil ##
* Kaufmännische oder gleichwertige Ausbildung
* Weiterbildung im Bereich Sozialversicherungen (z. B. Fachausweis Sozialversicherungen) oder die Bereitschaft diese zu absolvieren.
* Fundierte Kenntnisse im ZL-Bereich sowie in angrenzenden Sozialversicherungen
* Führungserfahrung von Vorteil - wichtig sind uns Entscheidungsfreude und Durchsetzungsvermögen
* Sie führen selbstsicher, freundlich, zielorientiert und empathisch
* Analytische, verantwortungsbewusste und sehr speditive Arbeitsweise; sicher im schriftlichen Ausdruck
* Echtes Interesse an sozialen Fragestellungen und Verständnis für die Anliegen behinderter und betagter Menschen
* Integrität, Loyalität und Verschwiegenheit sind für dich selbstverständlich
* Bereitschaft, sich vertieft in den Fachbereich der Abteilung (Asisstenzfälle inkl. SEBE, ausserordentliche Finanzierung, ausländische Renten) einzuarbeiten - und Freude am Umgang mit Zahlen
## Wir bieten ##
Wir bieten eine äusserst interessante und vielseitige Tätigkeit im sozialpolitischen Umfeld, eine umfassende Einarbeitung und eine spannende Laufbahn mit individuellen Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Ihr Arbeitsplatz liegt mitten im Herzen der Stadt Zürich, beim Stauffacher. Zudem profitieren Sie von den attraktiven Anstellungsbedingungen der Stadt Zürich.
